status: DEFAULT (pipeline.DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO_CONFIG, ADR 0068). Fixed before any evolve strategy has reached the portfolio stage (0 VALIDATION_SURVIVOR in every recorded context). A change needs a new versioned file and an ADR.
note: Separate from promotion_v5.json: promo-v5 (the individual-strategy criteria) is unchanged. This is an ADDITIONAL veto layer: a VALIDATION_SURVIVOR (= PASS_INDIVIDUAL) enters a locked campaign and promotion only with portfolio_status PASS_PORTFOLIO. Passing it is a necessary condition about account risk, never evidence of an edge (the members were selected on the same validation window).
data: validation window of each member symbol (already read by the StepM batch and robustness of these members). Never the locked TEST window, IW0/IW1 or any sealed data.

composition.rule: standalone (the candidate alone) AND joint (the candidate + the book). Book = strategies of the same experiment context whose latest portfolio record is PASS_PORTFOLIO and whose current status is not REJECTED, INCONCLUSIVE or PAPER_FAILED. Members sorted by strategy id; equal weights; no weight is fitted to data.

stress_partial_latency.note: diagnostic only: fill_ratio = share filled at the decision's entry open, the remainder fills at the next open with its own price and cost (cancelled if that is at/after the exit); latency = entry 1 bar later with the exit re-derived from the strategy's own exit rule. Uncalibrated (no real fills exist).

max_gross_exposure: sum of entry notionals / equity at the entry open (not multiplied by leverage): 1.0 at 1x, 3.0 for the 3x stress
thresholds_source: base checks reuse portfolio.PORTFOLIO_PASS_CRITERIA (final equity > initial, MDD < 0.5, 0 liquidations, not bankrupt) and the validation sample minima of promo-v5 (30 events, 30 days); the cross 3x stress adds no new numeric threshold, only 0 liquidations / no bankruptcy.
